PLANNED SERVICES

A clearer scope.
A practical outcome.

Choose a starting point that fits your practice. Scope, availability, delivery capability and fees are agreed before any engagement.

01 / BRONZE

Practice foundations

Designed for solo practitioners and small teams that want an understandable starting point.

What the review covers

  • Inventory of business accounts, devices and suppliers.
  • Account-security questionnaire and recovery contacts.
  • Public website information and supplier disclosures.
  • Questions to resolve with existing IT support.

What you receive

A written inventory and prioritised action checklist, separating verified observations from unknowns.

Not included: internal system access, intrusive testing, certification or continuous monitoring.

02 / SILVER

Supplier & account review

For practices ready to examine their everyday settings with permission.

What the review covers

  • Foundations review and agreed account configuration checks.
  • Two-factor authentication, permissions and recovery options.
  • Supplier responsibilities and data flows.
  • Priorities to discuss with your IT provider.

What you receive

Documented findings and a remediation plan showing actions, owners and evidence needed to confirm completion.

Scope limit: access only to agreed accounts. A supplier relationship does not authorise testing the supplier.

03 / GOLD

Continuity & assurance

For practices that want a structured plan for disruption and follow-up.

What the review covers

  • Supplier and account review.
  • Incident contacts, recovery priorities and continuity planning.
  • Agreed follow-up checks and ownership of actions.
  • Specialist assessment coordination where appropriate.

What you receive

A response and recovery plan, an action register and an agreed review schedule.

Not a guarantee: no service can establish that a practice will never suffer an incident. Any testing requires separate scope and qualified delivery.

Before work begins

Confirm the systems in scope, authorised contacts, access arrangements, deliverables, fees and exclusions in writing. Insurance and certification are not included in these proposed packages.
